title: Pluralistic Alignment in Large Language Models: Objectives, Human References, and Preference Representations
abstract: arXiv:2610.24471v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Pluralistic alignment aims to represent meaningful variation in human preferences rather than collapse heterogeneous judgments into a single target. Yet existing work often mixes three distinct questions: what pluralistic behavior a model should exhibit, whose preferences define the reference, and what evidence is sufficient to demonstrate success. We organize the literature around a two-layer taxonomy. Layer 1 distinguishes representing a range of human-supported viewpoints (Overton Pluralism), adapting faithfully to a specified perspective or preference condition (Steerable Pluralism), and matching the response distribution observed in a target population (Distributional Pluralism). Layer 2 distinguishes aggregate populations, countries and regions, and subgroups as human references. translated_title: 大语言模型中的多元对齐：目标、人类参照与偏好表征
translated_abstract: 多元对齐旨在表征人类偏好中有意义的差异，而不是将异质的判断坍缩为单一目标。然而，现有工作常常混淆三个不同的问题：模型应展现什么样的多元行为、谁的偏好定义了参照标准，以及什么样的证据足以证明成功。我们围绕一个双层分类体系来组织相关文献。第一层区分三种多元对齐目标：表征一系列得到人类支持的观点（Overton多元性）、忠实地适应特定观点或偏好条件（可引导多元性），以及匹配目标人群中所观察到的回应分布（分布多元性）。第二层区分三类人类参照：聚合人群、国家和地区、以及子群体。偏好表征、实现机制、模态和证据质量则被视为贯穿各层的设计选择，而非附加特性。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个双层分类框架来系统梳理大语言模型多元对齐研究，第一层区分三种对齐目标（表征多元观点的Overton多元性、适应特定视角的可引导多元性、匹配人群分布的分布多元性），第二层区分三类人类参照（聚合人群、国家和地区、子群体），并将偏好表征、实现机制等视为贯穿性设计选择。
en_tdlr: This paper organizes pluralistic alignment research for LLMs through a two-layer taxonomy that distinguishes three objectives (Overton, Steerable, and Distributional Pluralism) and three human reference types (aggregate populations, countries/regions, and subgroups), treating preference representation, mechanisms, and evidence quality as cross-cutting design choices.
